_note: The devices the Gugulethu pilot budgets for, drawn in the MyThuso and GilbertOne look for the funder view (apps/web/src/features/PilotKit.tsx). Chosen from the Alibaba.com sourcing catalogue Gilbert shared on 13 October 2026; the catalogue numbers are its own. No prices here: what the pilot spends on devices is the budget's to say, in funder-brief.json, so this file cannot disagree with it. The catalogue items are the ones the budget's devices line is priced on (funder-brief.json, ask.budget), so the picture and the figure name the same things.
status: Branding mockup. Nothing is ordered, and none of these devices is registered with SAHPRA for use in South Africa yet.
readingsNote: The readings on the screens are made up, to show where the MyThuso and GilbertOne marks sit. They are not anyone's results.

devices.name: Nurse handheld
devices.source: 4G medical PDA with NFC for nurse and patient ID
devices.role: The nurse's MyThuso workspace: the day's visits, the visit code, and the handover to the doctor.

devices.name: Health check station
devices.role: Blood pressure, glucose, ECG and temperature at the visit, sent to the visit record so the nurse does not retype them.

devices.name: Pulse oximeter
devices.source: Wellue Checkme O2 Max, CE marked
devices.role: Oxygen level and pulse at the visit, and overnight when a doctor asks for it.

devices.name: Household SOS band
devices.source: 4G SOS health monitor with fall detection
devices.role: For older patients who live alone. A fall or the button calls up to three numbers the family chooses; it is not an ambulance.

devices.name: Clinic tablet
devices.role: For the clinic side: the day's queue and bookings, at the front desk.
